title: Saving a role without changing anything leaves its access identical
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. API replays from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logins: Admin (edits roles); a user on custom role "QA PL Create&Edit" (Part Library & Inventory View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked). Data: QAPL-E1 (Part Library entry), QAPL-T1 (inventory part). DevTools open in the Create & Edit user's session.
custom_steps:
1. As the Create & Edit user: Parts > Part Library > open QAPL-E1; then Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-T1.
  2. As Admin: open Roles & Permissions (Settings > Roles & Permissions per PRD S12-R6; the handoff calls the menu Administration) > Edit Role on "QA PL Create&Edit" and read the Part Library and Inventory boxes.
  3. Click Save without toggling anything.
  4. Reopen Edit Role on "QA PL Create&Edit".
  5. As the Create & Edit user: reload, then repeat step 1.
  6. As the Create & Edit user: QAPL-E1 > pencil > change the Description > Save (watch Network), then restore it.
custom_expected:
1. Before: the entry shows the pencil (button_edit_catalogue_part); "Edit Inventory Part" opens with the Part Status radios disabled and no Delete Part.
  2. "Part Library & Inventory — View" and "— Create & Edit" are on; "— Delete" is off.
  3. No diff modal, or a diff modal that lists no added or removed "Part Library & Inventory" permission; the role saves.
  4. The same boxes as in step 2: View and Create & Edit on, Delete off.
  5. Identical to step 1: pencil shown; Part Status radios disabled; no Delete Part.
  6. POST /api/parts-catalogue/change-catalogue-part returns 200; the description is restored.
